title: Bernoulli’s Equation
sourceLocation: Owner's ChatGPT Library (master stays outside public GitHub)
frameworkClassification: P-11-B-40 summative; P-11-B-39 formative context in original source
sourceCognitiveTagsStatus: teacher-provided K/U/A reference only; not individual board-certified cognitive mapping
sourceScope: Ideal steady, incompressible and non-viscous streamline-flow Bernoulli relation, conservation of mechanical energy, pressure/kinetic/potential terms, horizontal and vertical applications, supplementary pressure/height/speed calculations and real-world scenarios. Named applications/devices belong to subsequent Topic 6.6.
importantDistinction: B-39 is formative; the official summative topic is B-40. The original K/U/A key tags are author annotations, not independently certified per-item exam demands. Equation is for ideal/no-loss flow along a streamline; pumps, significant viscosity and nonideal cases need extended energy balances.
limitations: Original 80 questions, answer letters, options, explanations and teacher key cognitive tags retained, with extracted PDF line wraps normalized; four split teacher key explanation rows rejoined from displayed source.
All 20 original section-IV situation/scenario-labelled questions are independent and do not include a shared multi-question stimulus.
Q13/Q14 mention textbook Fig.6.9, but ask about stated pressure-work directions; neither requires interpreting a diagram to select the answer. No figure hold.
This is public self-practice, not an official board examination and no cloud grades saved.
Central Test Builder stays V83 with 2,004 selectable questions; Unit 6 has 314 from Topics6.1–6.4, full Unit6 remains planned.
